prompts.floor-slabs.png: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: ONE seamless modular isometric dungeon FLOOR TILE, genuine transparent background. Reference is the exact existing floor tile; preserve its outer diamond footprint, shallow stone side lip, camera angle, matte hand-painted game style and desaturated warm charcoal-grey stone palette. Change ONLY the masonry pattern of the top surface: THREE long rectangular flagstones laid in staggered courses with one smaller end stone. Unequal lengths, narrow recessed seams, softly chipped corners, subtle worn bevels. Different from the reference's repetitive square grid. Continuous flat walkable floor, not a pedestal, step, wall, object or raised rocks. No metal, gold trim, grass, glow, holes or debris. Orthographic 2:1 isometric, left/right corners horizontally level, top/bottom corners aligned, light upper left. Full diamond fits image with transparent margin, no ground shadow or background, no text, no checkerboard. One tile only. Large readable simple stone shapes that fit a 120px-wide game tile.
